emails.subject: Free extra distribution for City of Windsor's facilities tenders
emails.body:
Hello City of Windsor procurement team,

PMRFP (pmrfp.com) is a free board where commercial roofing, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, janitorial, landscaping, snow and general contractors in Canada and the U.S. look for building and maintenance work.

We'd like to list City of Windsor's public facilities and construction tenders on PMRFP, at no cost to you or to bidders, to reach more local contractors.

What we would show: the tender title, a short summary, closing date, your procurement contact and a link back to your official posting. Your portal stays the official source. We don't copy documents, bidders register and submit through your system as usual, and we update or remove any listing on request.

You already publish your current opportunities on your own website, and your site terms ask for permission before the content is reused, so we haven't listed anything. With your agreement we would read that public list once a day, politely, identified as "PMRFP tender indexer".

If that's acceptable, a reply saying so is enough. If you'd prefer, you can also copy notices@pmrfp.com on the notices you already send, or point us to a feed you're happy for us to use.

Thank you,
